menu.name: Name
menu.randomTip: Another random terrain with the same settings

knobTips.rockLevel: How much rock: you build on it, and ore lies on it
knobTips.swampLevel: How much swamp: nothing can drive through it
knobTips.zoneScale: Large plateaus and deserts, or a fine mosaic
knobTips.biomeScale: How far salt flats, red wastes and marshes stretch
knobTips.peakChance: How many mountains on the rock: you cannot drive or build through them

menu.weatherChanges: Weather changes: wind, rain and storms
menu.blankTip: Flat sand with no rock, swamps, mountains or deposits
menu.noSaves: No saves yet. Start a new game or load a file.
menu.editorTip: Edit the world: map, bases, units, money and stores
menu.notSavedYet: This slot's world has not been saved yet
menu.newWorldTip: A map with exact dimensions: generated or a blank desert
menu.fileToEditorTip: Edit a save file without creating a slot: a server's world, for example
menu.lagTip: Debug: artificial delay in each direction, to get a feel for a bad network
menu.sharedWorld: A server has one world for everyone: you cannot restart it or save it locally.
menu.resolutionTip: How many pixels the world is drawn in: fewer is faster but the pixels are bigger. The interface stays sharp.
menu.terrainTip: How smooth the ground looks when the camera is far away: higher is smoother, lower is faster.
menu.shadowsTip: How precisely headlights cast shadows from buildings and vehicles at night.
menu.weatherTip: How many drops, splashes and layers of snow you see in bad weather.
menu.fpsTip: Fewer frames mean less heat and battery drain.
menu.graphicsNote: Lower is faster on weak devices. Applies at once; hover a name to see what it does.
menu.selectionTip: How bright the rings around selected units and the frames around buildings are
menu.minimapTip: The minimap side in pixels. 140 is level with the bottom bar; larger ones rise above it
menu.stepsTip: The first steps list in the top right corner of the game
menu.aboutText: A multiplayer browser RTS: a founding vehicle, a procedural map, mining and refining ore, cargo logistics and base defence.

help.list: who is in the game now
help.me: write about yourself in the third person
help.ally: offer an alliance to a leader or a loner, or accept theirs: you don't attack each other and share scouting
help.unally: with a name — kick an ally (leader), withdraw your offer or decline theirs; without a name — leave the alliance (a leader disbands it)
help.give: transfer credits to an ally: the money arrives at once
help.editor: live world editor: the whole map without fog, edits are seen by everyone at once; once more — leave
help.hide: vanish for players: not in the list, joining and leaving are not announced; once more — reappear
help.say: write to everyone on behalf of the server
help.kick: disconnect a player; their base stays
help.credits: set a player's credits; +N and -N add and subtract
help.players: all players of the world: number, online or not, credits, units and buildings
help.spawn: place units at a player's base (for yourself — without a nickname)
help.killunits: remove all units of a player or of everyone (all); buildings stay
help.heal: fully repair a player's vehicles and buildings
help.reset: wipe everything a player has and give them a new starting kit
help.reveal: reveal the whole map to a player
help.stop: save the world and stop the server

host.noAdminMode: This server has no administrator mode
host.adminOn: Administrator mode is on: /help shows what you can do now
host.editorOn: Editor: edits are seen by everyone at once. /editor — leave
host.tooManyNewcomers: Too many new players have been created from your address, try again later
host.versionOld: Version mismatch: the server has protocol {server}, you have {client} — download the new version of the game
host.versionNew: Version mismatch: the server has {server}, you have {client} — the server is older than the client and needs an update
host.deposit: A deposit goes on rock, away from the foot of a cliff and not overlapping another one
host.allyNotHead: Only the alliance leader can invite
host.allyToMember: {name} is a rank-and-file ally: alliances are offered to a leader or a loner
host.allyOffered: Alliance offered to {name}. Waiting for an answer
host.allyFormed: Alliance with {name} formed: you don't attack each other and share scouting
host.allyKickNotHead: Only the leader can kick: to leave yourself — /unally without a name
host.allyNoAlliance: You are not in an alliance
host.giveNoAlly: {name} is not an ally: you can only transfer to allies
host.ferrySent: Ship to {name} under way: money and cargo aboard
host.ferryComing: {name} sent you a ship: money and cargo aboard
host.ferryArrived: Ship reached {name}: the gift is unloaded
host.ferryGot: Ship from {name} arrived: the gift is unloaded
